状态指会员批准已完成，不是所有条款已实际执行。合同范围与生效条款须核原件；不把咨.en: Status refers to completed member ratification, not implementation of every provision. Contract scope and effective terms require the original. Discussion of alternative tools is not an individual veto over AI. September 10, 2026 supplementary check of MOA item 14: consultation requires an employee request and sufficient production time; arbitration under the AI provision excludes injunctive relief, which does not establish that all other legal remedies are unavailable. Scanning a person’s visual likeness or voice requires separate consent. The version read still has an effective-date placeholder; the final agreement remains to be checked.

It is not a collective declaration or technical test; claims about consciousness, architecture, hands and modality limits remain the author's 2023 views, not findings about current capabilities. 2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI.sourceText: 2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI 音乐授权原则，要求区分对既往使用、训练、生成输出及未来利用的支付，并让权利人参与决定授权范围与价值。这是行业组织提出的谈判框架，不是已签订的统一许可协议或法定收费标准。

2026 年 9 月 30 日，IMPF 与 IMPEL 联合提出生成式 AI.en: On 30 September 2026, IMPF and IMPEL proposed principles for generative-AI music licensing. They distinguish payments for past uses, training, generated outputs and future exploitation, and call for rightsholder involvement in scope and valuation. This is an industry negotiating framework, not a concluded collective licence or a statutory tariff.

第三巡回上诉法院在 25-2153 号案件中维持关于 2,243 条 Westl.en: In case 25-2153, the Third Circuit affirmed the copyright and fair-use ruling concerning 2,243 Westlaw headnotes. The opinion records a filing date of 29 September 2026; the court’s public list records the case on 30 September. The dispute concerns protected summaries used for a competing legal-search system. The ROSS system at issue was not generative AI.

This reasoning depends on the products, material and evidence in this case; it is not a blanket ruling that all generative-model training infringes copyright.

2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1.sourceText: 2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1 日生效，修订《刑法》第 8-301 条，将特定 AI 和深度伪造行为纳入身份欺诈规制。相关禁止要求明知、故意和欺诈意图，并针对冒用身份造成伤害及特定虚假记录行为，不是对 AI 艺术或风格模仿的一般禁令。
2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1.zh: 2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1 日生效，修订《刑法》第 8-301 条，将特定 AI 和深度伪造行为纳入身份欺诈规制。相关禁止要求明知、故意和欺诈意图，并针对冒用身份造成伤害及特定虚假记录行为，不是对 AI 艺术或风格模仿的一般禁令。
2026 年 5 月 12 日批准的 SB 8／第 445 章于 10 月 1.en: SB 8 / Chapter 445, approved on 12 May 2026, takes effect on 1 October and amends Criminal Law §8-301. It brings specified AI and deepfake conduct within identity-fraud rules. The relevant prohibition requires knowing, wilful conduct and fraudulent intent, addressing harmful impersonation and specified false-record practices rather than generally banning AI art or stylistic imitation.

官方修订版财政与政策说明明确，相关条款涉及通过冒充、虚假描绘或声称代表某人造成伤.sourceText: 官方修订版财政与政策说明明确，相关条款涉及通过冒充、虚假描绘或声称代表某人造成伤害，以及出于法定目的制作或传播虚假记录；受害人可就相关禁止行为请求禁令或其他适当救济。“深度伪造”的定义排除绘画、漫画、雕塑等列明形式，但这并不是对一切 AI 相关违法行为的全面艺术豁免。

官方修订版财政与政策说明明确，相关条款涉及通过冒充、虚假描绘或声称代表某人造成伤.en: The revised official fiscal and policy note explains harmful impersonation, false depiction or claimed representation, and creation or distribution of false records for specified purposes. Victims of the relevant prohibited conduct may seek an injunction or other appropriate relief. Listed forms such as drawings, cartoons, sculptures and paintings are excluded from the deepfake definition; this is not a blanket artistic exemption from every AI-related offence.

政府草案拟将符合条件的非独占集体许可扩展至未委托权利人，允许随时反对。第5条要求.sourceText: 政府草案拟将符合条件的非独占集体许可扩展至未委托权利人，允许随时反对。第5条要求集管组织在收到反对后尽快、最迟10个工作日内终止相应效力并通知使用者；第7条另要求使用者自收到组织通知后尽快、最迟10个工作日内排除作品。第6条要求公开告知，但不要求逐一通知。两处期限起点不同。 / The government draft proposes extending qualifying non-exclusive collective licences to non-mandating rightsholders with an ongoing right to object. Article5 gives societies up to ten working days after an objection to end the relevant effect and notify users; Article7 separately gives users up to ten working days after society notification to exclude works. Article6 requires publicity but not individual notification. The two deadlines have different triggers.

政府草案拟将符合条件的非独占集体许可扩展至未委托权利人，允许随时反对。第5条要求.en: The government draft proposes extending qualifying non-exclusive collective licences to non-mandating rightsholders with an ongoing right to object. Article 5 gives societies up to ten working days after an objection to end the relevant effect and notify users; Article 7 separately gives users up to ten working days after society notification to exclude works. Article 6 requires publicity but not individual notification. The two deadlines have different triggers.

D’Souza的参与者回顾记载2023年10月至2024年10月工作坊、装置与公共活动；Listening Machine在项目中构思、后期完成设计，面向未来工作坊，不据此倒推早期活动已使用最终工具。作者称有意识回避参与者认为涉及数据提取和版权问题的专有应用；不等于全流程离线或没有外部API。 线上发表日见封面；收稿与接受日期不作发表日。PDF标示CC BY-NC-ND 4.0。 批次495续读PDF7–34页，全文文本现已核读，图像/视频未视觉核验。p413及注5记录2025年5月反思对谈；注5称访谈/工作坊记录依Tate规范取得知情同意，未取得同意书核验。p402与注14写声音装置首次展示于2025年10月，而图13标题写2024年10月；src-0887–0888支持2024年活动，尚不能独立确定装置首展。p407、418声称无需企业平台/外部服务器，与src-0885当前README的Anthropic API依赖不一致；历史版本未核，不能据此认定作者虚假或工具全程离线。p410写工具在项目结束后完成，与前文后期设计完成分开记录。

Page 413 and note 5 date a reflective dialogue to May 2025; consent is author-reported, not independently audited. Page 402/note 14 date the sound installation presentation to October 2025, but figure 13 says October 2024. Sources 0887–0888 support a 2024 programme, without independently establishing the installation premiere. Claims on pages 407/418 of no corporate-platform/external-server dependence conflict with current README API requirements; historical versions remain unchecked. Page 410 places completion after the programme, distinct from earlier design completion.

报告2024年，确切发布日未核。方法记5月26–6月24，招募公告5月27，不强.zh: 报告属2024年；方法所列5月26日至6月24日与5月27日招募公告分开记录。1614名会员在线回应，报告自述门类偏差，并非法国总体随机样本；图表未视觉核验，不映射孤立数字。第745批核尾页第763行，确认2024年9月出版，确日未知。16%的活动下降为受访者自我归因，非因果估计；45%的报酬变化分母是报告条件有变化的10%子群。Hugo服务预计2025年初上线，非实际运行核验。
报告2024年，确切发布日未核。方法记5月26–6月24，招募公告5月27，不强.en: The report concerns 2024; its survey interval of 26 May–24 June is recorded separately from the 27 May recruitment notice. There were 1,614 online member responses, with acknowledged disciplinary imbalance, not a random national sample. Charts were not visually checked and isolated numbers are not mapped to them. Batch 745 checked the colophon at line 763, confirming September 2024 publication, without an exact day. The 16% activity decline is respondents’ attribution, not a causal estimate. The 45% pay-change figure concerns the 10% subgroup reporting changed conditions. Hugo’s expected early-2025 launch was a forecast, not verified operation.

2023-09-07为申请日、12-01为决议日；2024-05只是当前文件路径.zh: 2023年9月7日为申请日，12月1日为决议日；2024年5月只是当前文件路径。早先未读第4—8页，未声称已通读；申请图像未直接查看，模型与提示词未知。通知、救济和最终效力仍待核。批次808于2026年10月17日渲染并核读其余印刷页4—8，与批次807合计覆盖11页正文，第12物理页为空白。第4页将登记描述为宣告、证明性质而非创设权利，第5页限定此次登记职能，第6—8页讨论人类原创表达并区别软件工具与AI生成具体表达。这些是2023年行政机关的理由；所引法律和判例未另取原件，不代表现行法律全面核验。第4页提到数字艺术分类和JPG附件，不表示档案已取得原作品。本轮两组西语检索未取得通知、复议或上诉原件；不证明没有救济或决定已终局。
2023-09-07为申请日、12-01为决议日；2024-05只是当前文件路径.en: The application was filed on 7 September 2023 and the decision issued on 1 December; May 2024 is only the current file path. The initial review did not cover pages 4–8 and did not claim a complete reading. The submitted image, model and prompts remain unexamined; notice, remedies and finality are unresolved. On 17 October 2026, batch 808 rendered and read the remaining printed pages 4–8. Together with batch 807, this covers 11 substantive pages; physical page 12 is blank. Page 4 describes registration as declaratory and evidentiary rather than constitutive of rights; page 5 limits the registration function; pages 6–8 discuss human original expression and distinguish software tools from AI generation of specific expression. These are the authority’s 2023 reasons. Cited laws and cases were not separately obtained, and current law was not comprehensively checked. Page 4 records a digital-art classification and JPG attachment; the archive has not thereby obtained the artwork. Two Spanish-language searches retrieved no original notice, review or appeal record; this does not establish absence of a challenge or finality.

2023-09-07为申请日、12-01为决议日；2024-05只是当前文件路径.zh: 2023年9月7日为申请日，12月1日为决议日；2024年5月只是当前文件路径。早先未读第4—8页，未声称已通读；申请图像未直接查看，模型与提示词未知。通知、救济和最终效力仍待核。批次808于2026年10月17日渲染并核读其余印刷页4—8，与批次807合计覆盖11页正文，第12物理页为空白。第4页将登记描述为宣告、证明性质而非创设权利，第5页限定此次登记职能，第6—8页讨论人类原创表达并区别软件工具与AI生成具体表达。这些是2023年行政机关的理由；所引法律和判例未另取原件，不代表现行法律全面核验。第4页提到数字艺术分类和JPG附件，不表示档案已取得原作品。
2023-09-07为申请日、12-01为决议日；2024-05只是当前文件路径.en: The application was filed on 7 September 2023 and the decision issued on 1 December; May 2024 is only the current file path. The initial review did not cover pages 4–8 and did not claim a complete reading. The submitted image, model and prompts remain unexamined; notice, remedies and finality are unresolved. On 17 October 2026, batch 808 rendered and read the remaining printed pages 4–8. Together with batch 807, this covers 11 substantive pages; physical page 12 is blank. Page 4 describes registration as declaratory and evidentiary rather than constitutive of rights; page 5 limits the registration function; pages 6–8 discuss human original expression and distinguish software tools from AI generation of specific expression. These are the authority’s 2023 reasons. Cited laws and cases were not separately obtained, and current law was not comprehensively checked. Page 4 records a digital-art classification and JPG attachment; the archive has not thereby obtained the artwork.

决议拒绝2023-09-07提出的艺术作品TOCIX登记（1-2023-8806.sourceText: 决议拒绝2023-09-07提出的艺术作品TOCIX登记（1-2023-88060）；记录申请自述AI制作并据此推缺少具体人类创作介入。为DNDA行政决定，非法院终审、新立法或对所有AI辅助作品的个案审查。页10–11列通知及复议/上诉路径；未核通知日期、是否申请救济或最终状态。 / Refuses TOCIX application1-2023-88060 filed7 September2023, inferring insufficient concrete human creative intervention from its AI-production description. DNDA administrative decision, not final court judgment or new legislation. Notice/review/appeal route stated, actual notice, challenge and finality unverified. Batch808(2026-10-17)：已实际渲染并看完余下印刷pp4–8，连同807已读页现覆盖11页正文（第12物理页为空）。p4称登记为宣告/证明性质非权利创设，p5限定本次登记职能；pp6–8论人类原创表达并区分软件工具与AI生成具体表达。此为2023行政机关理由，所引法律/判例未另取原件，不推当前法律全面核查。p4记录数字艺术分类/JPG附件，不代表档案已取得原作品。 / Batch808 visually reads remaining printedpp4–8, completing11 substantive pages across two rounds. Reasons distinguish declaratory/evidentiary registration and human expression/tool use. These are the authority’s2023 reasons, not independent review of every cited law/case or current law. JPG attachment is recorded, not obtained.
决议拒绝2023-09-07提出的艺术作品TOCIX登记（1-2023-8806.zh: 决议拒绝2023年9月7日提出的TOCIX艺术作品登记申请（1-2023-88060），依据申请人自述AI制作推断缺少具体人类创作介入。这是DNDA行政决定，非法院终审、新立法或对所有AI辅助作品的审查。第10—11页列通知、复议及上诉路径；实际通知、救济及最终状态未核。批次808于2026年10月17日渲染并核读其余印刷页4—8，与批次807合计覆盖11页正文，第12物理页为空白。第4页将登记描述为宣告、证明性质而非创设权利，第5页限定此次登记职能，第6—8页讨论人类原创表达并区别软件工具与AI生成具体表达。这些是2023年行政机关的理由；所引法律和判例未另取原件，不代表现行法律全面核验。第4页提到数字艺术分类和JPG附件，不表示档案已取得原作品。
决议拒绝2023-09-07提出的艺术作品TOCIX登记（1-2023-8806.en: The decision refuses the TOCIX artwork registration application (1-2023-88060), filed on 7 September 2023, inferring insufficient concrete human creative intervention from the applicant’s description of AI production. It is a DNDA administrative decision, not a final court judgment, new legislation or a review of all AI-assisted works. Pages 10–11 state notice, review and appeal procedures; actual notice, remedies and final status remain unchecked. On 17 October 2026, batch 808 rendered and read the remaining printed pages 4–8. Together with batch 807, this covers 11 substantive pages; physical page 12 is blank. Page 4 describes registration as declaratory and evidentiary rather than constitutive of rights; page 5 limits the registration function; pages 6–8 discuss human original expression and distinguish software tools from AI generation of specific expression. These are the authority’s 2023 reasons. Cited laws and cases were not separately obtained, and current law was not comprehensively checked. Page 4 records a digital-art classification and JPG attachment; the archive has not thereby obtained the artwork.

页面署期2026年4月，无日级发布日期；502位受访会员，97.2%位于南非，不.zh: 页面署期2026年4月，无日级发布日期。502位受访会员中97.2%位于南非，不能代表全非洲艺术家。2026-09-11补核18题，未见抽样框、回应率、田野起止日、逐题有效样本或逐人原始回答；开放题是机构整理的主题，不是具名创作者逐字发言。Q9法律前提未独立核验。第147批复核0–414行，第321批复读样本及Q1–Q16，第481批复读样本、18题及结语，均未发现可证新事件；这不表示全站无更新，工作坊兴趣也不等于实际举办。第524批核Q15–18：Q17的90.4%包括66.9%确定及23.5%可能参加，不是出席率；Q15/18需求不能证明版税或检测规则已采纳。第820批仅读当前标题、样本和Q1–Q10，不推定新田野或全国代表性；态度和工具使用属于自报。第879批于2026-10-20复读0–414行，继续区分规制与许可偏好和政策实施，保留地域、样本及多选限制，无新可证节点。
页面署期2026年4月，无日级发布日期；502位受访会员，97.2%位于南非，不.en: The page is dated April 2026, with no day-level publication date. Of 502 responding members, 97.2% were based in South Africa; they do not represent artists across Africa. Review on 11 September 2026 covered 18 questions but found no sampling frame, response rate, fieldwork dates, per-question valid sample sizes or individual raw responses. Open answers are institutional thematic summaries, not attributed verbatim testimony. Q9’s legal premise has not been independently checked. Batch 147 reread lines 0–414; batch 321 reviewed the sample and visible Q1–Q16; batch 481 reread the sample, all 18 questions and conclusion. None established a new event; this is not a claim that the entire site was unchanged, and workshop interest is not delivery. Batch 524 checked Q15–18: Q17’s 90.4% combines 66.9% definite and 23.5% possible attendance, not actual attendance. Requests in Q15/18 do not establish adopted royalty or detection rules. Batch 820 read only the current header, sample and Q1–Q10, without establishing new fieldwork or national representativeness; attitudes and tool use remain self-reported. Batch 879 reread lines 0–414 on 20 October 2026, retaining geographic, sample and multiple-choice limits and distinguishing regulatory or licensing preferences from implementation. No newly evidenced node was identified.

预告与回忆分列；Ligot观点经Dalisay记忆转述，不冒充录音逐字引语或已证.en: The announcement and later recollection are kept separate. Dalisay recalls Ligot’s views; this is neither a verbatim recording nor evidence of general laws of AI. Both sources are in English; no Filipino edition is presumed. A full recording, policy, work permissions, model version and reception remain unverified; images, audio and video were not reviewed. ‘Implemented’ concerns the source-supported forum, not adoption of protective policy. The 25 October date combines the announcement and subsequent ‘last week’ recollection; the actual starting minute was not verified.

部门议会答复为官方立场，不是新资助禁令、自动资格保证或两片遭拒证明；未资助不等未.sourceText: 部门议会答复为官方立场，不是新资助禁令、自动资格保证或两片遭拒证明；未资助不等未申请、拒绝原因或无其他商业支持。影片国庆首映仅部门自述，原片/创作者/具体日期及训练许可未核。未读议会原逐字稿、申请记录、全部计划规则及后续变更；页尾30Oct2026更新非答复日或已证修改史。不推政府认可两片内容。 / Official reply,not a new ban,automatic eligibility guarantee or proof of rejected applications.No funding does not establish whether they applied,why rejected or commercial support.Premieres are ministry-reported;films,credits,exact dates and training rights unverified.Hansard,applications,all scheme rules and later changes unread.Footer30October2026 is not reply date or verified revision history.No inferred content endorsement.

部门议会答复为官方立场，不是新资助禁令、自动资格保证或两片遭拒证明；未资助不等未.en: Official reply, not a new ban, automatic eligibility guarantee or proof of rejected applications. No funding does not establish whether they applied, why rejected or commercial support. Premieres are ministry-reported; films, credits, exact dates and training rights unverified. Hansard, applications, all scheme rules and later changes unread. Footer 30 October 2026 is not reply date or verified revision history. No inferred content endorsement.

ACE公布法律顾问拟订的参考条款：AI学习用途不包含在通常让权中并由作者保留，但.en: ACE publishes advisory clauses reserving AI-learning uses outside the ordinary grant, while requiring prior express publisher permission for the author to exercise them during the contract. Another clause requires a warranty that creation did not use AI-related systems, tools or techniques. Advisory wording/circulation is distinct from execution, adoption and legal effect. Reservation is not unrestricted independent licensing; an author warranty is not a universal publisher ban. Full contracts, individual adoption, negotiations/disputes and the linked CEDRO original remain unread; not legal advice or a judicial finding. No historical capture.

Van Duyne、Clarke和Foushee于6月2日提出H.R.9112并.sourceText: Van Duyne、Clarke和Foushee于6月2日提出H.R.9112并转交众议院司法委员会。法案拟保护符合定义的、故意针对可识别视觉艺术家的AI风格冒用，区别于版权及商标；保留一般艺术影响、独立人类创作及限定表达例外，通用模型仅有相似输出能力不足以触发责任。它尚不能作为现行权利使用。 / Van Duyne, Clarke and Foushee introduced H.R.9112 on 2 June and referred it to House Judiciary. It proposes a right distinct from copyright/trademark for defined, deliberately targeted AI visual-style impersonation, preserving general artistic influence, independent human authorship and qualified expressive exceptions. Mere similar-output capability of general-purpose models is insufficient for liability. It is not a presently operative right.

Dwór Artusa原节目列6May2023 19:00于Toruń Sala.zh: Dwór Artusa的原节目安排THORNET于2023年5月6日19时在托伦Sala Malinowa演出，时长约一小时，将AI编剧输入与真人即兴编导结合，并列出内容及研究准备负责人Wiktor Walentynowicz和合作者。该页仍为邀请式预告，“已归档”不证明实际举办；模型、提示词、输出、现场接口与训练许可未明，不能具体认定为ChatGPT。不采纳“世界最早之一”的宣传；每场独特是即兴过程自述，不是全球首演排名。编者认为其意义在于地方剧场中人类现场编导与生成语言的协商，不是机器自主替演。AI辅助双语摘要待人工复核，仅保留链接。
Dwór Artusa原节目列6May2023 19:00于Toruń Sala.en: The Dwór Artusa programme schedules THORNET for 6 May 2023 at 19:00 in Toruń’s Sala Malinowa, for about one hour. It combines AI script input with human improvisation and credits Wiktor Walentynowicz for content and research preparation alongside collaborators. The invitation and archived label do not prove delivery. Models, prompts, outputs, live interfaces and training permissions are unspecified; ChatGPT cannot be assumed. The promotional primacy claim is not adopted. Each show’s uniqueness describes improvisation, not a global premiere ranking. Editorial interpretation: its relevance lies in local theatre’s negotiation between human live direction and generated language, rather than autonomous machine replacement. The AI-assisted bilingual abstract awaits human review; link-only.
